consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1990-07-14 show at Sullivan Stadium was a solid performance, highlighted by strong first and second sets. Many praised the energy of the band and the memorable moments, particularly the double encore and standout songs like 'Eyes of the World' and 'Shakedown Street.'
